licence: UNVERIFIED (no public dataset or terms found). WV Code 17C-4-14: Division of Highways tabulates crash reports and publishes statistics.
notes: WVDOT's Traffic Accident Data page only says to email a named contact (Marsha.K.Mays@wv.gov). No crash layer found on the WVDOT open data portal or ArcGIS Online. MPOs (e.g. MMMPO) get data from WVDOT, so consultants can get exports.

years: SHACA (internal) shows 2015-2024 county summaries; public HDOT ArcGIS layers only give Oahu 2007-2018 per-location counts (fields: mode, year, count; no severity)
licence: HDOT Safety Analytics: crash data "provided for highway safety and educational purposes only. Use of this data constitutes agreement with this policy" (cites 23 USC 407). OIP Opinion 05-06: 23 USC 409 does not make the database confidential, but DOT need not produce it in the electronic form requested.
aadt_source: https://services.arcgis.com/HQ0xoN0EzDPBOEci/arcgis/rest/services/AADTMap/FeatureServer (AADT2016); HPMS2021AADT layer in the same HDOT org
city_open_data: Honolulu 'Traffic Incidents' (ykb6-n5th) is a 24-hour police dispatch feed (date, type, address; 164 rows), not crash reports: https://data.honolulu.gov/Public-Safety/Traffic-Incidents/ykb6-n5th
notes: The statewide crash system (SHACA, built from county police MVARs) is internal. The public CARTO 'Safety Analytics' platform shows crash maps, but no record-level download was confirmed (UNVERIFIED). Use FARS as the public fallback for fatal crashes.

location: unknown (police report allows street address or route + distance from a landmark, per NHDOT block-grant map instructions)
licence: UNVERIFIED. Crash reports fall under the DMV records statute (RSA 260:14); whether that bars bulk release is UNVERIFIED.
aadt_source: UNVERIFIED (NHDOT counts are run with RPCs, e.g. https://therpc.org/maps-and-data/data/traffic-counts-and-volume-reports; no statewide AADT service URL confirmed)
